hero.label: Hero
hero.description: A big centred headline, two buttons and the product below

hero-split.label: Hero, split
hero-split.description: Headline and buttons beside a picture

statement.label: Statement
statement.description: A big sentence beside a short paragraph, no picture

logos.label: Logos
logos.description: A row of the names of customers or partners
logos.use: Only customers or partners the request names; never invent a name. Without them, leave the section out.

text.label: Text section
text.description: A title and a few paragraphs

updates.label: Updates
updates.description: Three announcement cards with a date and a category

story-grid.label: Story grid
story-grid.description: A lead story and many smaller ones in a dense grid, for a front page

list.label: List
list.description: A numbered list of short linked items with a date, for a sidebar

features.label: Features
features.description: Wide tiles with pictures and small tiles with icons

feature.label: Feature
feature.description: One feature beside a picture; tag the box #reverse to swap sides

stats.label: Numbers
stats.description: Four large figures with a line of text each
stats.use: Only figures the request gives, each with what it counts; never invent one. With fewer than three real figures, use highlight for one, or leave the section out.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.description: One big quote, then three smaller ones
testimonials.use: Only quotes the request gives, word for word, with who said them; never write a quote and put a name on it. Without real ones, leave the section out.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.description: Three plans, the popular one on a dark card
pricing.use: Only plans and prices the request gives, as many cards as it has plans (one or two is fine), and the popular one marked only when the request says. A price you don't know is a plain example listed at the end of your answer.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: A title beside questions that open to show the answer
faq.use: Each question is a <details> with its <summary> inside the accordion: add or remove whole ones. Only questions the request gives or clearly implies, with answers that are true; a question without a real answer goes.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: A centred statement with two buttons

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.description: Pictures of work with a title and a year
gallery.use: Real pictures (the person's, placed with add_picture) or drawn ones that fit; a gallery of placeholders says less than none. Titles and years only when they are known.

card-grid.label: Card grid
card-grid.description: Products or services as small cards with a picture, a tag and a price, under a row of filters
card-grid.use: Prices only when the request gives them. The filters are links: point each at a section or a page for that kind, or remove the row when there is only one kind.

image.label: Image
image.description: One picture with a caption; the box handles size it

contact.label: Contact form
contact.description: Ways to reach you beside a form
contact.use: The form says thank you when it is sent, but it sends nowhere until its action is the address of a form service the person gives: say so in your answer. The email and phone are links (mailto:, tel:) to the real ones; a way to reach people the request doesn't give is a plain example listed at the end of your answer.

article.label: Article
article.description: Title, summary, image and body text

docs-content.label: Docs page
docs-content.description: Title, text, code and a note

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: A small label with a mark, a big title and a paragraph, no picture

figure-cards.label: Figure cards
figure-cards.description: Large figures on dark cards, each with an icon, a label, a line of text and a bar
figure-cards.use: Only figures the request gives, never invented ones; each bar's width (style="width:…%") shows its figure as a share, so set it from the figure. Without real figures, leave the section out.

bar-chart.label: Bar chart
bar-chart.description: A ranked list of items with a value and a bar each, more under Show more, and a source
bar-chart.use: Only real values, with the source line saying where they come from; never invent one. The items past the first few go under Show more.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.description: One figure on a soft card with a round icon, a title and a sentence
highlight.use: One real figure the request gives, never an invented one; without it, use another component or leave the section out.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.description: Dated steps along a line, side by side on a wide screen
timeline.use: Only real dates and steps; never fill a gap in a CV or a history with an invented one.

image-banner.label: Picture banner
image-banner.description: A wide picture with its caption over a dark fade, and a strip with a button

steps-rail.label: Steps on a line
steps-rail.description: Three or four steps hanging from one line that fills as the section scrolls into view, each with a figure

hero-switch.label: Hero with a switcher
hero-switch.description: A hero that speaks to several audiences: pills switch the headline, text, figures and the card over the picture
hero-switch.use: The first pill shows the first headline, case and card, the second the second, up to four: keep the pills, the headlines (.v), the cases and the cards the same number, in the same order.

case-intro.label: Case opening
case-intro.description: A case study's title with a highlighter stroke on its key words, a short lead and a strip of facts under a heavy rule

case-cover.label: Work in a frame
case-cover.description: The finished work in a plain window frame, with a caption and a link to see it live

case-brief.label: Story in three parts
case-brief.description: The brief, what was done and what changed: three numbered columns, each under its own rule

case-decisions.label: Decisions
case-decisions.description: Cards that each say what was chosen over what, why, and what it cost

case-compare.label: Before and after
case-compare.description: The same view before and after, side by side, each with a tag and a caption

case-quote.label: Pull quote
case-quote.description: A quote in words only: a large opening mark, the quote and who said it
case-quote.use: Only a quote the request gives, word for word, with who said it; never write one and put a name on it.

case-credits.label: Credits
case-credits.description: Who made it, role by role, and what it was built with, as chips

case-next.label: Next case
case-next.description: One wide link to the next case study, between two rules

page-banner.label: Page banner
page-banner.description: A title and one sentence over each page, shared by every page; each page fills in its own (slots)
page-banner.use: Shared by every page of a site: its title and its sentence are slots each page fills (set_slot). Change the block itself only for what every page shows.

offer-list.label: Offer list
offer-list.description: What a place offers, in groups: a name, a line and a price (optional) for each

hours-location.label: Hours and location
hours-location.description: Opening hours or times beside a picture of the map, the address and a link to a map
hours-location.use: Hours by day, as the request gives them. The map button links to https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<the address>, and the picture of the map is one you draw (add_picture) or the person's.

programme.label: Programme
programme.description: What happens when: a time beside each moment of the day, in order

people.label: People
people.description: The people behind it: a round picture, a name, a role and one line each
people.use: Only people the request names, with their real role; never invent a name. Without their photos, use initials or no picture, never a made-up face; without names, leave the section out.

side-nav.label: Side menu
side-nav.description: A menu beside the page: the pages of this part of the site, in groups

side-note.label: Side note
side-note.description: Beside the page: the facts people look for first (when, where, who to ask) and related pages

page-text.label: Page text
page-text.description: The page's title and a few paragraphs: where a page made from a frame alone starts.
